name: World Model -- sovereign semantic capture, substrate defrost, and the daily 'real story' synthesis
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-30/31. Founding diagnosis (verbatim): 'AI agents are not coherent. They lack a world model ... resources are generated with little to no situational awareness ... our ontology and efforts to combat it are futile without an actual world model.' The ratified frame: we have never CAPTURED a world model because the only entity holding it was never asked to serialize it -- and THE OFFTAKE THAT MATTERS IS THE DISAGREEMENT, NOT THE VERDICT (every instrument-vs-ruling delta is classed; the recurring classes ARE the schema). Direction ruled: 'the entire purpose of comp-estate is that its the global lossless fidelity descent from semantics to facts' -- every existing instrument climbs facts-upward and stalls below meaning, so the descent needs a semantic rung that EXISTS. This project builds and keeps it, in three limbs. LIMB A -- THE CAPTURE WALK (in flight): resource-by-resource sovereign adjudication, instruments commit BLIND then Andrew rules then the delta is classed. DONE: S3 35/35, DynamoDB 37/37, 19 resources decommissioned (all archived pre-delete, 404/NotFound-verified, positive-controlled), 30 ontology classes, C-1..C-17 consequences, Q-1..Q-33 investigation queue dispatched to 0.7.0. REMAINING: EventBridge groups 2-13 (99 of 154 triggers), compute layer (192 lambdas + EC2 fleet), IAM last. LIMB B -- SUBSTRATE DEFROST (designed, unbuilt): estate-coverage-resolver.json is a JOIN of a LIVE hand-adjudicated manifest and a census FROZEN at 2026-06-15 with NO refresh path -- measured consequence, a served artifact narrated 'LIVE fresh 2026-06-15' whose live truth was 45 days newer. Cardinal rule (Andrew-direct): 'we can never ever have dependencies on frozen maps', landed in docs/doctrine/CHECK_LIVE_NOT_FROZEN.md. Design splits 10 census fields 5-deterministic / 4-prose / 1-key: compile the deterministic half at run time so the stale-able file ceases to exist; date the prose per-field and review-queue it when its compiled half moves. LIMB C -- TEXT RECORDING + 'THE STORY' (CVO/Kimi-held, CTO is FYI + the deployment-motion sourcing leg): rulings 5/6/7/7a -- every text of Andrew's terminal input tracked day-by-day, synthesized with git change + deployment motion into <1000 characters a day, '5-10 sentences that actually mattered and a couple reference pointers', which he feeds back. Ruling 6: the corpus is USER INPUT / tribal knowledge, a git-activity summary is 'useless for high signal key semantics' -- and both his named examples are this program's own capture. Ruling 5: the end-to-end loop through MSTR is what keeps the reference artifact accurate, and 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~A consumes that live fire for the CTO-side investigative work. Load-bearing design points, each measured rather than proposed: the <1000-char constraint IS the design problem (selection, never summarisation); the loop closes on itself (his feedback is tomorrow's input); curation is demoted by raw capture (the ledger's unique value collapses to the DELTA); exercise keeps a reference honest, review is only its floor; PII/redaction is explicitly NOT a blocker (Andrew: 'we can always filter it later') with the single enabling constraint that the store stay deletable.
